products.name: Javathu
products.description: Traditional javathu buds blended into a soft, powdery floral — the everyday fragrance of South Indian homes and pooja rooms.

products.name: Jasmine
products.description: Madurai mullai picked at dawn and hand-rolled into sticks — a sweet white-floral that fills the home like a temple courtyard at dusk.

products.name: Champa
products.description: Classic nag champa with its warm, resinous depth — the scent of deep darshan hours and quiet evening prayers.

products.name: Lavender
products.description: Cooling herbal lavender, sun-dried and blended for a soothing, meditative atmosphere.

products.name: Screw Pine
products.description: Kewra — the fragrant screw pine of the Tamil coast — distilled into a rich, vanilla-tinged floral beloved for festive occasions.

products.name: Rose
products.description: Panneer rose petals from the temple gardens, layered into a deep, velvety fragrance for abhishekam and archana.

products.name: Sandal
products.description: Pure Mysore sandalwood, ground and blended the traditional way — the most sacred of all offerings, warm and long-lasting.

products.name: Sacred Resin
products.description: Guggul and frankincense resins over charcoal — the ancient smoke of homams and temple sanctums, in stick form.
